purpose: Use material or experience as the starting basis for something new.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
N + をもとに / をもとにして
I wrote a short novel based on my grandmother’s stories.
We improved the screen using users’ feedback.
We reconstructed the old town using an old map.
formation: N + をもとに / をもとにして
restrictions: Often describes creative adaptation or development from source material.
mistake: It need not mean every detail of the source is reproduced.
